tasks.title: results_view.py: the pure parser, pager, page window and link builder for the results view
acceptance: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide `src/vramsherpa/results_view.py`, importing nothing from `main.py` and needing no session or request, with a frozen dataclass `ResultsView(verdict, page, page_size)`, `parse_results_view(params)` (`params` has `getlist`, as Starlette's `QueryParams` does), `paginate(total, view)` giving page, first, last, total, last_page and page_size, `page_window(page, last_page)` and `view_query(raw_query, verdict=None, page=1, page_size=5)` (ADR-0014 point 1).

WHEN `parse_results_view` reads `verdict`, THE SYSTEM SHALL use the last value if repeated and accept exactly `fits`, `tight` or `wont-fit`; anything else, including `FITS`, `green`, empty and `<script>`, SHALL be no verdict (R-088).
WHEN `parse_results_view` reads `page_size`, THE SYSTEM SHALL use the last value and accept exactly `5` or `10`; anything else, including `7`, `abc`, `1000` and empty, SHALL be 5 (R-088).

WHEN `parse_results_view` reads `page`, THE SYSTEM SHALL use the last value and accept only `re.fullmatch("[0-9]+")` values of at least 1; `abc`, `0`, `-1`, `1.5`, `+2`, `1_000` and non-ASCII digits SHALL be page 1, and a value too long for a 64-bit integer, such as 5000 digits, SHALL count as above the last page without raising (ADR-0014 point 3).
WHEN there is no valid verdict, THE SYSTEM SHALL return page 1 and size 5, ignoring `page` and `page_size` (R-088).

WHEN `paginate` runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL lower a page above the last page to the last page and give 1-based first and last card numbers: 71 at size 5 page 2 is 6 to 10 of 15 pages; 71 at size 5 page 99 is 71 to 71 on page 15; 71 at size 10 page 8 is 71 to 71; 9 at size 5 has 2 pages; 9 at size 10 has 1 (R-087, ADR-0014 point 4).

WHEN `page_window` runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL return numbers with `None` for each gap: page 1 of 15 is `1 2 … 15`; page 6 of 15 is `1 … 5 6 7 … 15`; page 15 of 15 is `1 … 14 15`; page 10 of 19 is `1 … 9 10 11 … 19`; page 3 of 15 is `1 2 3 4 … 15`, with no gap where no number is left out; page 1 of 1 is `1` (R-087).

WHEN `view_query` runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL split the raw query on `&`, drop empty parts and parts whose percent-decoded key is `verdict`, `page`, `page_size` or `apply_view`, keep every other part byte for byte and in order, then append `verdict`, `page` and `page_size`, leaving out `page` at 1 and `page_size` at 5; with `verdict=None` it SHALL append none of them (R-088, ADR-0014 point 5).
THE SYSTEM SHALL provide `tests/test_results_view.py` covering every example above, repeated `family=a&family=b` kept in order, `vram_gb=abc` kept, and percent-encoding unchanged.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT change any page in this task: every existing test passes unchanged.

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).
tasks.notes: UI: no. Pure module, no wiring (T-037 wires it). Use `[0-9]`, not `\d` (Python's `\d` matches other scripts' digits). Python's `int()` raises above 4300 digits, so check the length before converting (HLD test strategy names the 5000-digit page). Decode keys with `urllib.parse.unquote_plus`, compare decoded, but keep the original bytes in the output. No file under `static/`, so no `ASSET_VERSION` bump.

tasks.title: One card list: every model becomes a card, counts tally the cards, verdict lists sort on the server
acceptance: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide `_default_variant(variants)` in `main.py`, taking a model's variants in Q4, Q5, Q8, FP16 order: the recommended variant if usable, else the first usable; with none usable, the recommended variant, else the first (R-016, ADR-0015 point 1).

THE SYSTEM SHALL make `_group_results_by_model(rows)` return one `ModelCard` for every model left after filters, skipping none, with `default_variant_id` from `_default_variant` (R-014, ADR-0015 point 2).

THE SYSTEM SHALL make `_summary_counts(cards)` tally `card.default_variant.classification`, so one rule places a model and a model with no usable variant counts under `Won't fit`: the reference query gives 71, 0, 24; `vram_gb=1` gives 0, 0, 95; `vram_gb=8&context_tokens=2048&family=llama` gives 6, 4, 4 (R-023, ADR-0015 point 3, R-089).

THE SYSTEM SHALL provide `_verdict_cards(cards, label)`: `Fits` and `Tight` sorted by `(-params_b, model_name, model_id)`; `Won't fit` by `(required_vram_gb - available_vram_gb of the open variant, -params_b, model_name, model_id)`, unrounded, with `model_name` compared by code point, so `Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct` sorts before `gemma-3-1b-it` (R-019, ADR-0015 point 4).

WHEN `_verdict_cards` runs on `data/` seeds for the reference query, THE SYSTEM SHALL start `Fits` with `DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct`, `DeepSeek-V2-Lite`, `DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat`, `Qwen2.5 14B Instruct`, `DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B` (R-086).

WHEN `_verdict_cards` runs for `Won't fit` on the reference query, THE SYSTEM SHALL give positions 1 to 5 `Qwen3-30B-A3B`, `Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507`, `Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct`, `DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B`, `Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct`; positions 16 to 20 `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731`, `DeepSeek-R1`, `DeepSeek-V3`, `DeepSeek-R1-0528`, `DeepSeek-V3-0324`; and positions 21 to 24 `DeepSeek-V3.1`, `DeepSeek-V3.2`, `DeepSeek-V4-Pro`, `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813` (R-086).

WHEN `_verdict_cards` runs for `Won't fit` at `vram_gb=1`, THE SYSTEM SHALL give positions 6 to 10 `Qwen3-0.6B-Base`, `Llama-3.2-1B`, `Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct`, `gemma-3-1b-it`, `phi-1_5`; with `quant_bucket=Q8` on the reference query the first SHALL be `Qwen3-30B-A3B` at 20.9 GB over (R-086).

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep every page as it renders today in this task: `model_cards` in `_results_context` stays the `Fits` cards then the `Tight` cards, in today's order, so every existing test passes unchanged.
THE SYSTEM SHALL cover R-016's no-usable branch in `tests/test_verdict_lists.py`, with a recommended variant and with none left after filters.
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT change `estimation.py`, `/how-it-works` or `ESTIMATION_POLICY_VERSION` (R-086, rule 16).

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).

tasks.title: Read the view on all four routes: a valid verdict gets its sorted page of cards; no verdict stays as today
acceptance: THE SYSTEM SHALL read the view with `parse_results_view(request.query_params)` in `_results_page_context`; no handler SHALL declare `verdict`, `page` or `page_size`, so no value can produce a 422, on `/results` and all three partials (ADR-0014 point 2, R-088).

WHEN a valid verdict has a count above 0, THE SYSTEM SHALL set `model_cards` to only that page of `_verdict_cards`, and pass the view and the `paginate` result to the template (R-087, ADR-0015 point 5).

WHEN a valid verdict has a count of 0, THE SYSTEM SHALL pass no cards and treat no verdict as selected. WHEN there is no valid verdict, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep today's `model_cards` in this task (T-039 removes them).

THE SYSTEM SHALL put `data-verdict` on `#summary-banner` for a valid verdict, including one whose count is 0, and `data-page-size` when the size is not 5, writing only canonical values (ADR-0016 point 1).

WHEN these load, THE SYSTEM SHALL send this many `data-model-card` elements: reference query `&verdict=fits` 5; `&verdict=fits&page=15` 1; `&verdict=fits&page_size=10` 10; `&verdict=fits&page_size=10&page=8` 1; `/results?vram_gb=8&context_tokens=2048&verdict=tight` 5, with `page=2` 4, with `page_size=10` 9; `…&family=llama&verdict=tight` 4; `/results/partials/list?…&verdict=fits` 5 (R-087, R-090).

IF `page`, `page_size` or `verdict` is invalid, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 as R-088 states: `page=abc`, `0`, `-1`, `1.5` show page 1; `page=99` and a 5000-digit page show the same cards as `page=15` with no `Location`; `page_size=7`, `abc`, `1000` and empty show 5 cards; `verdict=tight&verdict=fits` uses `fits`; `verdict=green`, `FITS` and empty select nothing.
WHEN `/results?vram_gb=24&verdict=%3Cscript%3E` loads, THE SYSTEM SHALL write no `<script>` from that value and no `data-verdict` into the body (R-088).

WHEN `…&verdict=wont-fit` loads, THE SYSTEM SHALL show R-086's cards through the route, each with `<x> GB over`, `bar-wont` at `width: 100.0%`, `<required> GB needed`, `<available> GB`, `data-oversize` on every quantisation button and `How this is estimated`; page 1 of the reference query starts `Qwen3-30B-A3B` at `4.4 GB over`, `page=5` ends `DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813` at `1486.4 GB over` (R-086).

THE SYSTEM SHALL guard in a test that `.quants button[data-oversize][aria-pressed="true"]` sets `color: var(--on-pressed)` after the `.quants button[data-oversize]` rule in `styles.css` (design README, "What did not work" item 2).
WHEN `/results/partials/summary?…&verdict=fits` is requested, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with no model card (R-090).
THE SYSTEM SHALL add URLs 10 to 13 of R-080 to `tests/test_cache_control.py`: 200, `text/html`, exactly one `Cache-Control` with `no-cache` or `no-store` (rule 9).

WHEN `/results/partials/content?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=4096&family=qwen&family=llama&verdict=fits` has no `HX-Request`, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 302 to `/results?` plus the same query byte for byte; with `HX-Request: true` it SHALL send the same string in `HX-Push-Url`; `/results?verdict=fits` with no hardware and no `HX-Request` SHALL still redirect to `/` (R-081, R-088, R-013).
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT change `estimation.py`, `/how-it-works` or `ESTIMATION_POLICY_VERSION` (R-086, rule 16).

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).

tasks.title: /results opens on the gist: no card without a selected verdict, headline from the counts, the notes and the zero-count message
acceptance: WHEN a request has no selected verdict, THE SYSTEM SHALL pass no cards: for the reference query the body SHALL contain `id="summary-banner"` and `Manual VRAM (24 GB)` and SHALL NOT contain `data-model-card` or `How this is estimated`, with or without `HX-Request: true`, on `/results`, `/results/partials/content` and `/results/partials/list` (R-084, Q-35).

THE SYSTEM SHALL state the headline as `<N> model(s) fit or are tight` with N the sum of the `Fits` and `Tight` counts in every view, using `model` when N is 1: `71 models` for the reference query on its gist, on `&verdict=fits&page=6` and on `&verdict=wont-fit&page=2` (R-014, R-023).

WHILE no verdict is selected and at least one count is above 0, THE SYSTEM SHALL show `Choose Fits, Tight or Won't fit to see the models.` under the counts; WHILE a verdict is selected, `Pick a quantisation on any card to see how it changes.`; WHILE all counts are 0, no note. `Only Fits and Tight models are listed.` SHALL NOT appear anywhere (R-084, R-085, R-022). `/results?vram_gb=1` keeps the note as drawn (Gate 2, Q-41).

IF a request names a valid verdict whose count is 0, THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with the gist and `No models in <label> with these settings.` in a `div.notice` with `role="status"`, after the tile's other notices and before the counts: `…&verdict=tight` on the reference query names `Tight`; `data-verdict` stays on the tile (R-085, R-089).

WHILE the catalog is seeded, no verdict is selected and `Fits` and `Tight` are both 0, THE SYSTEM SHALL show the empty state under the gist: `/results?vram_gb=1` and `/results?vram_gb=24&min_params_b=5&max_params_b=1` show it; the reference query does not. WHILE `Won't fit` is selected, `/results?vram_gb=1&verdict=wont-fit` SHALL show its list instead (R-025, R-084).

WHILE the empty state shows, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `There are <n> models in Won't fit, hidden by default.` and `There is 1 model in Won't fit, hidden by default.` as written, with the word `models` (R-069, copy table).
WHILE the catalog is unseeded, THE SYSTEM SHALL show R-026's two sentences and no note; a request naming a verdict SHALL also show R-085's message (HLD "The view").

WHILE a gist with a count above 0 shows, THE SYSTEM SHALL render nothing in the list area; `

Results

` SHALL render only above a list or the empty state (R-078's copy table keeps it above the cards).

THE SYSTEM SHALL still compute every model on each request, so a no-verdict `page` or `page_size` changes nothing: `/results?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=4096&page=3&page_size=10` equals the gist (R-088).
WHEN `/results/partials/content?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=4096` opens as a normal page load, THE SYSTEM SHALL end at `/results?…` showing the gist (R-081, R-078).

THE SYSTEM SHALL hold ADR-0014 point 7 in a test: for the reference query, `vram_gb=8&context_tokens=2048`, and the reference query with `verdict=fits`, `verdict=fits&page=6`, `verdict=fits&page=15`, `verdict=fits&page_size=10`, `verdict=wont-fit` and `verdict=tight`, plus `vram_gb=8&context_tokens=2048&verdict=tight`, the exact body of `/results/partials/content?<q>` with `HX-Request: true` SHALL appear inside the body of `/results?<q>` (R-084, R-090).
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT change `estimation.py`, `/how-it-works` or `ESTIMATION_POLICY_VERSION` (R-086, rule 16).

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).

THE SYSTEM SHALL replace `ul.counts` with `div.verdicts role="group" aria-label="Show models by verdict"` in the order `Fits`, `Tight`, `Won't fit`, each tile holding the verdict's icon, `<b class="num">` count and `<span class="vt-label">`, so its accessible name reads like `71 Fits`, with no second set of counts on the page (R-085, R-091).

WHILE a verdict's count is above 0, THE SYSTEM SHALL render an `a.vt` through `view_link` carrying `data-verdict-control="<slug>"`; WHILE it is 0, or the catalog is unseeded, a `span.vt` that is not a link and not focusable: on the reference query `Tight` is a `span` showing `0` (R-085, R-091).

WHILE a verdict is selected, THE SYSTEM SHALL mark only its control `aria-current="true"`, and that link SHALL drop all three parameters with `data-view-link="collapse"`; a request naming a zero-count verdict SHALL mark none (R-085, R-091).

WHEN `…&verdict=fits&page_size=10&page=2` loads, THE SYSTEM SHALL link `Won't fit` with `verdict=wont-fit&page_size=10` and no `page`; from the gist, `Fits` SHALL link `verdict=fits` with no `page` or `page_size` (R-085, R-088).

WHEN the query is `/results?vram_gb=abc`, `/results?gpu_id=no_such_gpu` or `/results?gpu_search=RTX`, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep that hardware in each control's link, and following the link SHALL answer 200 at the same 8 GB with the same message and no redirect; `family=a&family=b` SHALL stay in order; `verdict=%3Cscript%3E` SHALL appear in no link (R-088).

tasks.title: Results layout: the shells make no grid row, so a gist has no empty row and no stray gap
acceptance: THE SYSTEM SHALL set `#results-summary-shell, #results-list-shell { display: contents; }` and drop `#results-list-shell`'s `min-width` and grid placement (design README, "What did not work" item 4).

THE SYSTEM SHALL set, at 900 px and up, `.bento { grid-template-rows: auto 1fr; }` in place of `auto 1fr auto`, and `.results { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 3; }`, so the third row and its gap exist only when a list or the empty state does (R-084, measured 0 px under the picks).
THE SYSTEM SHALL give `.results` `min-width: 0`, which `#results-list-shell` provided, so R-070's 390 px `scrollWidth` holds.
THE SYSTEM SHALL set `.form-pane .filters { margin-top: auto; }`, pinning `Filters (N)` to the bottom of the form tile (design README, "What did not work" item 5).

tasks.notes: From ADR-0018's findings in htmx 1.9.12: `htmx:afterSettle` fires once for each new top-level element in the swap, and `#results-shell` swaps two children, so the focus step needs a one-shot flag set at `beforeRequest` (T-049 notes the kind there). `htmx:afterSettle` is shared with breakdown requests: filter on `detail.target.id`.
